author_instruction: 2026-10-17: add independent datasets, evaluate effectiveness, integrate all supported evidence into figures, tables, text and reviewer responses

heart_multicenter.outcome: num > 0 versus num = 0; contemporaneous diagnostic classification, not prospective incidence
heart_multicenter.features: the standard 13 predictors, with ? and -9 coded missing; no outcome or institution identifier as predictor
heart_multicenter.conditions: each of four centers held out as target, remaining three pooled as source
heart_multicenter.exclusions: invalid or missing diagnostic labels only; retain incomplete predictor rows
heart_multicenter.boundary: small historical cohorts; four related center comparisons, not four independent datasets

conditions: hospital A source to hospital B target
hospital B source to hospital A target
sepsis_hospitals.unit: one record per patient file; no hourly pseudo-replication
sepsis_hospitals.eligibility: at least 24 observed hourly rows, valid binary Challenge labels, no positive Challenge label during hours 1-12; require ordered ICULOS 1-24
sepsis_hospitals.outcome: any positive supplied SepsisLabel in hours 13-24
sepsis_hospitals.features: mean, last observed value and missing fraction for each of the first 34 physiological columns in hours 1-12; Age, Gender, Unit1, Unit2, HospAdmTime last observed in hours 1-12; exclude SepsisLabel and ICULOS
sepsis_hospitals.boundary: supplied Challenge labels begin six hours before clinical onset; endpoint is future Challenge-label transition, not a new clinical onset adjudication or reproduction of Challenge utility. Conditioning on >=24h observation is retrospective cohort selection. No future predictors, post-hour-12 measurements, hospital identifier or later stay length enter the predictor

roles: deterministic outcome-blind permutations for each dataset/condition/seed: source 70% proper training, 30% calibration; target 30% calibration pool, 70% untouched test; patient IDs disjoint; no target-guided tuning or failed-run redraws

models.elastic_net: source-fitted median imputation and standardization; categorical most-frequent imputation, one-hot encoding min_frequency=20; SGDClassifier loss=log_loss, penalty=elasticnet, l1_ratio=0.10, alpha=0.0001, max_iter=1000, tol=0.001, class_weight=balanced
models.lightgbm: same source-fitted preprocessing; LGBMClassifier n_estimators=120, num_leaves=31, learning_rate=0.05, class_weight=balanced, n_jobs=2; no target tuning

random_controls: whole-dataset outcome-blind 25% test, then 30% calibration within remaining development data, five seeds per model; contextual controls, not condition-size matched
thresholds: ceil((n+1)*0.90) sorted non-interpolated order statistic, infinity on rank overflow/absent class, inclusive ties, no argmax fallback; source full calibration, target nested uniform permutations

observation_channel_extension.budget: 10% of each full target domain, same five model seeds and five draws; report actual class counts and infinity rates

regimes.outcome_depleted: weight .2 for class1 and 1 for class0; retrospective availability stress test

observation_channel_extension.availability: independent Bernoulli eligibility probabilities min(1,c*weight), with c chosen for expected 2*n eligible rows; take uniform n eligible rows or all if quota insufficient; no resampling failed quotas
observation_channel_extension.sentinel: independent uniform n labels from full pool, alternative acquisition protocol; no equal monetary-cost claim

outcomes: AUROC and balanced accuracy as predictor diagnostics
aggregation: average draws within seed, then seeds within condition, then conditions within dataset; show all conditions and both models; keep new extension separate from original 12 conditions and original 528458-record summaries
integrity: download URLs and SHA256; source-only preprocessing; patient disjointness; fixed predictions; independent sorted-score reconstruction of all metrics and draw membership; all failures and non-supportive results retained
interpretation: external empirical validation, not universal superiority or proof of clinical benefit; no exact replication of numeric effect sizes assumed; no changing datasets, endpoints or methods after viewing coverage
